items.title: Ranau Hospital Crisis: Doctors Working 48 To 72 Straight Hours — Medical Officer
items.summary: Only 8 medical officers are running Ranau Hospital. We are on daily on-calls here, working for 48 to 72 consecutive hours, followed by 5-15 hours’ rest, before resuming another 48- to 72-hour shift. None of us have had a single day off in the past month. The post Ranau Hospital Crisis: Doctors Working 48 To 72 Straight Hours — Medical Officer appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Why Malaysia Lost Me To NHS Scotland — Scrub Nurse With HIV
items.summary: In Malaysia, I experienced job discrimination as a scrub nurse living with HIV from private hospitals and MOH. But NHS Scotland hired me, allowing me to work in OT. Under UK law and WHO guidelines, my HIV status is treated as a protected medical condition. The post Why Malaysia Lost Me To NHS Scotland — Scrub Nurse With HIV appeared first on CodeBlue .
